413-1003-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
413-1003-5006-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. When Phyrexian Walker enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

792-4279-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

907-1479-7892.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil the Strategist, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

884-1895-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-1895-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

6006-7060-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6006-7060-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6006-7060-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1978-2734-7434--148.notablePrerequisites:
There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
1978-2734-7434--148.description:
Animate Brass Infiniscope.
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
1978-2734-7434--148.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

423-1437-2895-3756.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-2895-3756.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Uro spell three times.
Resolve the first Uro copy.
The Uro token enters the battlefield, triggering both of its abilities.
Resolve the first Uro ability, sacrificing it. 
Resolve the other Uro ability, gaining 3 life, drawing a card, and putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting

112-6070-6496.manaNeeded: {10}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-6070-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-6070-6496.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Doctors.
112-6070-6496.description:
Cast Twice Upon a Time by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Twice Upon a Time and exiling the original Twice Upon a Time with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Twice Upon a Time copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Twice Upon a Time and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Twice Upon a Time's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Twice Upon a Time and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Twice Upon a Time's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-6070-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

1144-2645-3322-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

876-2510-7070.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
876-2510-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

5361-5775-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5361-5775-7009.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
5361-5775-7009.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Auton Soldier, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker. At end of combat, Fortune triggers, blinking it and Auton Soldier. Choose to have Auton Soldier enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1361-2073-4241.description:
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Ancient Den to become a creature until end of turn.
Ancient Den dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Ancient Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

431-851-4365-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-4365-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

892-1318-2743.description:
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Sublime Epiphany twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Sublime Epiphany spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

585-1399-1606-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
585-1399-1606-6071.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2781-6132-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Felidar Guardian.
2781-6132-6798.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4529-5256-6481.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Bontu.
When God-Eternal Bontu dies, it triggers, putting itself into your library third from the top.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Bontu's power, ultimately milling God-Eternal Bontu.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting God-Eternal Bontu from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

4231-4508-4875-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1170-4124-4826-5334-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2035-2523-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gollum.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Battle at the Helvault

1071-3158-3361-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Volcano Hellion.
Instead of you losing the game as a state-based action, Lich's Mirror causes you to shuffle your hand, graveyard and all permanents you own into your library, causing Rhox Faithmender to return to the battlefield as Battle at the Helvault leaves the battlefield, and causing you to gain life equal to twice the amount of damage dealt to you plus 40.

2034-3767-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Scuttling Sliver.
Scuttling Sliver does not have summoning sickness.
2034-3767-4702.description:
Activate Scuttling Sliver by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Scuttling Sliver token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Scuttling Sliver by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

638-1470-3584.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery this turn.
638-1470-3584.description:
Cast any other spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Cast Hinder by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting that spell.
Thousand-Year Storm and Thrumming Stone trigger.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, creating at least one copy of Hinder, with each copy targeting the original Hinder.
Resolve the first copy of Hinder, countering the original Hinder and putting it on top of your library.
All remaining Hinder copies fizzle due to no longer having a legal target.
Resolve the Thrumming Stone trigger from step 3, revealing the top four cards of your library and casting Hinder without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.

2199-4800.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet's ability an arbitrarily large amount of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and either sacrificing Frenetic Efreet or causing it to phase out.
If you win the flip, Chance Encounter triggers, putting a luck counter on it.
Resolve the next Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and not phasing out or sacrificing Frenetic Efreet due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2396-4971.notablePrerequisites:
Ophidian Eye attached to Niv-Mizzet.
You have a way to draw a card.
2396-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
